svg.title: Source–readout formulation. The source object is the two-curvature coefficient g ∈E2 ⊗E2; the readout is the double curl Curl2(g)h,i = P a,b symbol1(−p)a,h symbol1(p)b,i ga,b, valued in doubly transverse two-potential tensors. Theorem 14.9 constructs a section s2 with Curl2 ◦s2 = id on analytic doubly transverse tensors of order at least two, bounded by (TEL4) and lowering the order by two. The readout is not injective: its kernel contains C2 −(·) in the first slot and the analogous image in the second. The correction −C2 −D in (TEL2) is precisely a motion inside that kernel fibre, chosen to make the intermediate primitive transverse in the remaining slot. The realized history stores (X, Y, D, V, g); the readout recovers u and nothing more.
